transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Maestro Salieri, thank you for seeing me. Please, have a seat. I have reviewed your case thoroughly, and I must be candid.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Thank you, doctor. I appreciate it. Please, share with me what you have discovered.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Your symptoms—the trembling in your hands, the persistent headaches, the moments of confusion—they present a most puzzling picture. They do not align neatly with any single ailment I know.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Indeed, doctor. My hands are my livelihood, and I cannot afford to lose them. I understand that my cognitive functions may be affected as well, but I am determined to find a solution.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: I understand your determination, Maestro. However, I must insist you reduce your conducting duties immediately. The strain could be worsening your condition.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Conducting? You think I can simply cease my duties as a conductor?

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: For your own wellbeing, yes. It could be nervous exhaustion from overwork—the pressures of the court, the constant composing, the performances. But... it could also be the early signs of something more serious affecting the brain. We cannot ignore either possibility.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I... I see your point, doctor. Perhaps it is time for a change. A break from the responsibilities that have been weighing on me.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: That is wise. You must submit to further examination over the coming weeks. We shall monitor you closely. I cannot yet say whether your hands will recover their steadiness, but rest is the first step.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Very well, doctor. I shall do as you suggest. Thank you for your guidance.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: You are most welcome, Maestro. Your health is of utmost importance to the court—and to those who admire your music. I shall arrange for the examinations.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Thank you, doctor. I appreciate your concern. Rest assured, I will make the necessary adjustments to prioritize my wellbeing. Good day to you.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Good day, Maestro. I shall send for you next week. Please, do not hesitate to summon me if the symptoms worsen before then.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Very well, doctor. I shall be in your care. Thank you again for your attention. Good day to you.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Good day, Maestro. May God grant you strength and clarity.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Thank you, doctor. May His grace be upon us both. Good day.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Farewell, Maestro. Remember—rest is now your most important composition.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: You are right, doctor. Rest is indeed crucial. I shall take your advice to heart. Farewell.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Until next week, Maestro. I shall pray for your recovery.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Thank you, doctor. Pray for my health, as I pray for your well-being. Farewell.
